files.description: Playwright coverage for sync service choices, Folder target preview/export and consent, selection filters, import preview, and run history.

testContext: The suite uses the standard one-instance seed and runs serially because it creates sync automations and imports fixture photos. Folder target output is placed under Playwright testInfo.outputPath so the isolated app can write to it and the runner can discard it with test artifacts. Import source files are the checked-in yaffo_ui_tests/test_data/photos fixtures. Sync pages live at /utilities/automations/<slug>; setup panels are #sync-step-options and #sync-step-where; the header toggle is .automation-actions [role="switch"], Test is #sync-test, Run now is #sync-run-now, Items are under #sync-items, and run rows poll under #automation-runs. New automation selection lives in #newAutomationModal. The UI uses hidden native selects wrapped by .searchable-select-wrapper; select options through .searchable-select-display and .searchable-select-option.
explanation: Hand-written from specs/sync_automations.yaml after inspecting the sync detail, filter, item, and run-history templates plus setup and sync routes. The scenarios requiring live OAuth or external service accounts are left out of this isolated UI file; these tests focus on built-in Folder behavior that the seed sandbox can exercise without credentials.
